title: HDF Amendments
description: Waivers, attestations, exceptions, and POA&Ms that modify requirement compliance status. Amendments are standalone documents that can be applied to results via merge operations.

amendmentId.description: Unique identifier for this amendments document. Useful for cross-referencing when multiple amendment documents target the same results.

name.description: Human-readable name for this amendments document. Example: 'Portal Q1 2026 Waivers'.

description.description: Description of the amendments' purpose and scope.

systemRef.description: URI to the hdf-system document these amendments apply to.

appliedBy.description: Default identity of who created this amendments document. Individual overrides may specify their own appliedBy.

approvedBy.description: Identity of the authorizing official who approved these amendments.

overrides.description: The set of amendments (waivers, attestations, exceptions, POA&Ms).

labels.description: Optional key-value labels for grouping and querying amendments.

integrity.description: Cryptographic integrity information for verifying this amendments document has not been tampered with.

signature.description: Document-level digital signature covering all amendments.

generator.description: Information about the tool that generated this document.

overrides.reason: Compensating control: session timeout set to 15 min

evidence.description: ISSM approval with compensating control documentation
